use default

let digit_symbols = "0123456789abcdef"

render(value: long, base: int) -> string is
    let digits = LIST()
    let remaining mut = value

    while remaining > 0L do
        let digit = cast int(remaining % cast(base))

        digits.insert(0, digit_symbols[digit])
        remaining = remaining / cast(base)
    od

    return string(digits.to_array())
si

esthetic(base: int) -> Pipe[long] is
    let pending = Queue[(value: long, last: int)]()

    for digit in 1..base do
        pending.enqueue((cast long(digit), digit))
    od

    while true do
        let (value, last) = pending.dequeue()

        yield value

        for next in [last - 1, last + 1] do
            if next >= 0 /\ next < base then
                let extended = value * cast(base) + cast(next)

                pending.enqueue((extended, next))
            fi
        od
    od
si

for base in 2::16 do
    let shown = esthetic(base)
        |> skip(base * 4 - 1)
        |> take(base * 2 + 1)
        |> map(value => render(value, base))
        |> join(" ")

    write_line("base {base,2}, esthetic numbers {base * 4} to {base * 6}:")
    write_line("  {shown}")
od

show_range(low: long, high: long) is
    let matching = esthetic(10)
        |> filter(value => value >= low)
        |> take_while(value => value <= high)
        |> map(value => "{value}")
        |> collect_list()

    write_line("")
    write_line("base 10 esthetic numbers between {low} and {high}:")

    for row in 0..(matching.count + 9) / 10 do
        let cells = matching |> skip(row * 10) |> take(10) |> join(" ")

        write_line("  {cells}")
    od
si

show_range(1_000L, 9_999L)
show_range(100_000_000L, 130_000_000L)
